$schemaNote: Shrink-only cf toolchain operation queue. Each switched operation records parity evidence, allowlist deltas and Wrangler gaps that remain.

settings-readback.title: Worker settings preflight readback
settings-readback.wranglerPrior: No Wrangler CLI; production deploy jobs previously lacked bounded settings snapshots.
settings-readback.toolchain: Cloudflare Workers API GET snapshots (cf-aligned publisher contract)

rehearsal.notes: Hostile fetch fixtures bound at 28 GETs; cli child process proves stdout never echoes credentials.

allowlistDelta.note: Readback never invoked Wrangler; deployment-source compatibility strings remain under deployment-source-compatibility.

calendar-build-output.title: Calendar ASSETS-only cf Build Output publisher
calendar-build-output.wranglerPrior: wave1-native-publish.mjs wrangler deploy for Calendar staging and production qualification

rehearsal.notes: emitCalendarOutput secondaryModuleNames match the staged cf bundle tree; cf deploy --dry-run --no-provision on emitted Build Output; _headers/_redirects ship as plain assets.

allowlistDelta.note: calendar-cf-publisher drops wrangler deploy --dry-run; parity uses emit manifest versus cf bundle inventory only.

native-workers-gateway.title: Simple native Workers and gateway
native-workers-gateway.wranglerPrior: wrangler.jsonc plus Vite plugin configPath for api; gateway operator merge still reads wrangler.jsonc
native-workers-gateway.toolchain: cloudflare.config.ts, vp build, cf-worker-parity.mjs, cf deploy --prebuilt --dry-run

rehearsal.notes: Each workflow builds once, asserts cf-worker-parity, and runs cf deploy --dry-run without credentials.

allowlistDelta.note: apps/api/wrangler.jsonc removed; api package.json drops direct wrangler devDependency.

removalConditions: gateway-deploy-config.mjs reads cloudflare.config.ts instead of wrangler.jsonc

void-wave1-cf-publisher.title: Wave-1 Start+Void cf Build Output publisher
void-wave1-cf-publisher.toolchain: wave1-cf-output emit + cf deploy --prebuilt and cf workers versions create --prebuilt

rehearsal.notes: emitWave1Output inventory matches staged output; cf deploy --dry-run for activation; version-only path uses cf workers versions create with no traffic change.

productionTemplate.publisher: cf deploy --prebuilt --no-provision | cf workers versions create --prebuilt

allowlistDelta.note: wave1-native-publish and publication-harness retire wrangler deploy; shared cf-build-output-publisher centralizes calendar and wave-1 upload paths.

email-storage-do-void-publisher.title: Email, storage, Durable Objects and Void publisher
email-storage-do-void-publisher.wranglerPrior: Wrangler deploy --no-bundle via cf-wrangler-publication.mjs for SQLite DO Workers

rehearsal.notes: Validate job runs cf deploy --dry-run on emitted Build Output; production deploy publishes the uploaded artifact without Wrangler CLI.

allowlistDelta.note: coordination and devbox-control workflows drop wrangler deploy qualification and production publication steps.

gateway-m4-cf-version-rehearsal.title: M4 gateway cf version-only publication
gateway-m4-cf-version-rehearsal.wranglerPrior: wrangler versions upload and versions deploy@100% in web-opennext.yaml
gateway-m4-cf-version-rehearsal.toolchain: cf workers versions create --prebuilt when GATEWAY_CF_VERSION_UPLOAD_LIVE; Wrangler upload+deploy fallback when unset; Wrangler versions deploy for traffic after cf upload

rehearsal.notes: Rehearse when GATEWAY_CF_VERSION_UPLOAD_REHEARSAL is set. Production cf upload needs GATEWAY_CF_VERSION_UPLOAD_LIVE; traffic deploy stays Wrangler until owner coordinates first flip.

allowlistDelta.note: Default production path remains Wrangler; cf upload is owner-gated.

removalConditions: Owner enables GATEWAY_CF_VERSION_UPLOAD_LIVE after coordinated first use
Wrangler upload fallback retired when cf traffic deploy exists

observability-remaining-callers.wranglerPrior: wrangler tail and unmatched CLI operations
